reviews.review_description:
There's an open-world city. Up to 4 players in co-op. Parkour with a unique locomotion system. All in a survival crafting game? And it’s free to play?!!

I’ll update this review once our squad has played more, but judging by the first hour and a half, this might be the best release of the fall…

reviews.review_title: 7.7/10 potential to be a absolute succes
reviews.review_description:
Ok these are what i believe need to be addressed first 
-loot respawn 
Loot respawns way to quickly this makes it easy to infinitely farm locations with no difficulty easy fix just have loot respawn every maybe 2 in game days or adapt the walking dead mechanic of loot spawning less and less the more ingame days go by
-gripping items and using/placing items in holsters feels like it needs better calibration I find myself accidentally dropping items instead of pocketing them a lot more then i should this is also a issue with placing items in and or out of the chest
-dying needs a punishment 
I was extremely disappointed to find that after I died I kept everything i believe players should either drop their bookbag or something maybe even have less maximum health per respawn idk just something
-accessibility options are absolutely needed options like changing grip order adjusting holster height and etc are needed badly
-PERFORMANCE my first blood moon spawned so many zombies my quest 3s felt like it was gonna explode gotta optimize how many can appear on screen at once 
-items need a way to identify them easy fix just adapt TWD system of inspecting a item to get its name 
-map is great would love to see even more interiors (trust it’s already a lot I know but more is never worse especially for a open world game)
-sound like others have pointed out sound design is lacking 

Overall enjoying my experience would give a solid 7.7/10

reviews.review_title: The best Dying Light like vr game
reviews.review_description:
I really see the potential for this game to the Dying light VR game we've been waiting for, but it needs a few things first. 
I really think the game would benefit a graphical overhaul just made the game a tad more realistic 
Weapons need a bit more work, like two handing weapons feels awkward and you can't two hand handguns
Parkour feels good but I think grabbing on the edges still needs work 
More hand animations when interacting with objects 
Human NPCs would be nice and make the world feel more alive 
Human settlements in shopkeepers 
Besides that that's a really good game that has a lot of potential but right now it feels more like a tech demo for a potential game

TBH it is an interesting free game. Love playing it when it is working. Gory,nice movement and combat mechanics and items are kinda easy to get.But still there are some big issues that needs to be fix.First,please tune down the Blood Moon event cos it ALWAYS lag and crashes the game due the insane amount of OP zombies runnin around . Second,the quick slots (and all the item slots generally,including the storage crates)needs some calibrating as well.This make me lose items thinkin i stashed it already. Sometime,i can't even take out the item from the crates when i need em.

And yeah,IT CRASHES A LOT!Now i can't even start the game! Really hope my progress are still there. Please fix these.

Updated 18/11/2026: Unfortunately one of my characters(1 of 2) has been somehow corrupted and i can't load or join any server with it so i have to delete it and use the other one.Plenty of my times and items wasted on it and they are all gone. Hopefully everything's good for this  other one so i can continue my adventure ,make more prgress and possibly finish the game.

Thanks for the detailed feedback. We’re collecting reports like this and working on fixes.

Thanks for playing and for letting us know!
